olivia_sales: Acadia Health wants a 2-week Private deploy POC. They need: preserve client source IP to onprem proxy, mTLS from connector to their egress proxy, BYOIP for sticky egress IPs, and delta pricing vs Dedicated. Can we confirm constraints?

mike_netops: Clarifying: do they insist on PrivateLink only? If so, preserving original src IP is non-trivial. Options: 1) customer runs L4 passthrough on their edge (we can provide an appliance), 2) our egress NAT with BYOIP sticky EIPs (we own mapping). Passthrough = more customer infra; NAT+BYOIP = simpler but we manage EIPs and session stickiness.

jess_solutions: They'll ask about KMS/HSM, SOC2/ISO attestation, admin-plane segmentation, and log residency. I'll attach our compliance 1-pager and a short firewall snippet.

ryan_engineering: For the POC: Port 443 only. Recommend stable EIP pool for the two weeks. If using PrivateLink, ask them to open outbound 8443 to our control plane and accept X-Forwarded-For if we terminate mTLS at their proxy.

mike_netops: Firewall snippet (for their netops): `allow tcp from 203.0.113.100/32 to 10.1.0.0/24 port 443  # connector egress (BYOIP)`
`allow tcp from 198.51.100.0/28 to 10.1.0.0/24 port 443  # burst pool`
`# open outbound tcp 8443 to control-plane.redwood.example`
`# tcp keepalive: 30s to avoid NAT idle expiry`

infra_bot: POC created: POC-ACADIA-1767777000 owners: olivia_sales,jess_solutions,mike_netops start: 2026-05-12 duration: 14d

olivia_sales: Great. Can we get: 1) final firewall snippet (mike), 2) 1-slide network diagram showing Privatelink primary + TGW fallback (ryan), 3) compliance 1-pager (jess). I'll reply to customer EOD.
